title: Refocusing of Wheeler--DeWitt wave functions at inner horizons
summary: We study quantum gravitational effects inside hyperbolic black holes with both outer and inner horizons by solving the Wheeler--DeWitt (WDW) equation in the minisuperspace approximation. The WDW equation contains a tachyonic region where the effective potential becomes negative. We develop a numerical method that consistently evolves the wave function across this region and obtain stable solutions throughout the entire minisuperspace.
